title: ever ROSALYN|Ruffled Chiffon Sleeveless Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Elevate your wedding guest style with this stunning Ruffled Chiffon Sleeveless Dress! Featuring delicate ruffles that cascade gracefully, this dress offers a flattering silhouette perfect for dancing the night away. The lightweight chiffon fabric ensures comfort, making it an ideal choice for any celebration.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor-length.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: Side back zipper.


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
